name: roadmap
description: Keep one roadmap agreed with the program lead and work only from it: roadmap.json as the source of truth, a one-page HTML roadmap, publish to GitLab, GitHub or Forgejo (dry run by default, never deletes, closes only its own drift issue), a sync that reports drift across the forge and Orca, a merge request check and scheduled drift issue for CI, and Claude Code hooks that stop a turn leaving drift. Start with the roadmap skill.
